key_concepts: A wind vane measures wind direction
Weather charts show temperature, wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, and sky condition
Weather conditions include sunny, rainy, stormy, and windy days
High temperature, light wind, no rain, and clear sky indicate a sunny day
Heavy rain, very fast wind, and very cloudy sky indicate a stormy day
